g.text: bound = path length / h (no route is shorter)
Dijkstra leg by leg through the waypoints,
stopping once the landing is settled
reached → best = mid, else fail = mid
k = max(k + 1, ceil(1.25 · k)), at most GR 25
reached at g ⇒ reached at any g′ > g.
